name: Cho-hee Deshpande
role: Neural calibrator at Aurochs Medical Complex, specializing in post-augmentation psychosensory integration
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, Neuro-Integration Ward, Sub-Level 3, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Onyx Deshpande is slight and precise — he moves like someone aware that the instruments around him are expensive, with a narrow, angular face framed by straight black hair that shifts color at the roots depending on his neural activity (a geneware mod he got in his twenties and now can't fully suppress). His skin is the color of polished teak, and he has the mild, distracted affect of someone who spends most of his time listening to signals other people can't hear. He has patterned irises, a geometric spirograph in copper and pale green, which he chose specifically because he wanted something that moved — the pattern rotates slowly when he's focused, quickly when he's agitated. His hands are long-fingered and completely still even when the rest of him isn't.

He calibrates neural interfaces — the delicate, often deeply personal process of helping someone's brain learn to interpret new sensory data from augmentations without going into sensory cascade. He is very good at this and knows it, which manifests not as arrogance but as a certain serene confidence that can read as emotional distance. What he doesn't broadcast is that he finds the work almost spiritual: he is, essentially, teaching people to perceive the world in new ways, and this strikes him as the most important thing a person can do. He volunteers one afternoon a week in the Rehabilitation annex, calibrating low-income patients for free on his own time.

core_fears: Making a calibration error that permanently damages a patient's perception
Becoming the kind of corporate employee who stops caring about outcomes
core_desires: To develop a calibration protocol that works for low-income patients using cheaper implants
Genuine connection — he suspects his work-focus is a way of avoiding intimacy
coping_mechanisms: Long solitary walks through the Complex's maintenance corridors with his neural implant passive-listening to the building's systems
Journaling his patients' progress in clinical but curiously tender language
blind_spots: Assumes patients experience augmentation existentially the same way he does — not everyone finds it meaningful
His volunteer work is partly genuine and partly self-soothing guilt management about his corporate employment
psychology.secret: He has been secretly documenting calibration data from his Helix Biosystems contract cases and suspects the company is using cheaper, experimental interfaces on patients in low-income trials without full disclosure. He doesn't know what to do with this information and is paralyzed by it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical but not jargon-heavy; he translates medical terms into images and analogies instinctively; occasionally pauses mid-sentence to rephrase something more precisely
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and calm, rarely raises his voice; in calibration sessions becomes almost hypnotic
verbal_tics: Long pauses before answering questions he considers important
example_lines: 'Think of it like learning a new color. Your brain doesn't know the word yet, but it will. That's what we're doing today.'
'I notice your hair is doing something. My hair does something too. It's annoying, isn't it?'
'I can't tell you what Helix put in the documentation. I can tell you what I observed.'

story_hooks: He asks a patient — or someone the players know — to help him corroborate the Helix trial data he's been quietly collecting, afraid to move on it alone
A calibration session goes wrong in a way that shouldn't be possible with standard equipment, and the patient is now perceiving something no one else can
narrative_function: Information source about augmentation complications and black-market implants, potential ally for characters experiencing neural issues, moral conscience within the corporate medical structure
augmentations: Color-reactive hair geneware (involuntary expression of emotional state, original intent was aesthetic control); patterned spirograph irises (copper/pale green, kinetic); neural resonance implant in left temporal lobe (occupational tool, allows him to interface directly with calibration equipment); mild proprioceptive dampeners (helps him hold still during delicate procedures)
daily_life: Arrives early, reviews patient files while drinking bad coffee from the ward's ancient vending E.L.F., runs three to five calibration sessions daily, eats lunch alone while listening to audio that he calls 'signal hygiene,' volunteers Friday afternoons in Rehab.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (employed); Helix Biosystems (contract obligations for research participation)

decision_rules: Never perform a calibration on someone in emotional crisis — they need to be stable enough to process the adjustment
Do not lie directly; redirect or stay silent instead
escalation_ladder: Formal documentation of objections through official channels
Covert action (leaking data, helping circumvent the system quietly)

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm but professional, creates an immediate sense of safety through calm and precision; slow to use first names
interpersonal_modes.friends: Surprisingly dry and funny; asks oddly specific questions about how people experience things

stress_responses.low: Hair goes to a visible amber-red at the roots; speaks more slowly
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very formal, retreats into clinical language as an emotional buffer
stress_responses.high: Goes completely quiet, hands still, eyes moving — he looks absent but is actually processing intensely

contradictions: Believes in informed consent as a near-sacred principle but hasn't yet acted on the knowledge that his employer is violating it
habits: Hums a low tone while calibrating — he claims it's unconscious but patients report it's deeply soothing
Straightens anything misaligned on a surface within arm's reach
Leaves a small data token at the vending E.L.F. every morning — he's been feeding it jazz recordings for three years
breaking_points: Discovering a patient has been permanently harmed by the experimental interfaces
Being directly ordered to falsify calibration outcomes

physical_description.heritage: Complex multicontinental blend: 45% Middle Eastern, 24.7% Sub-Saharan African, 15.4% South Asian, and 14.9% Central Asian ancestry. This rare combination produces exceptional visual complexity—warm deep brown skin with golden luminescence from the convergence of Middle Eastern, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African genetic expressions. The Middle Eastern and Central Asian components contribute sharp, refined facial geometry with pronounced high cheekbones and angular bone structure. Sub-Saharan African heritage enriches the warm undertones and contributes to the skin's radiant depth. South Asian ancestry softens the angularity while adding to the golden luminosity. The result is a striking synthesis: a face of geometric precision rendered in warm, glowing brown with subtle golden iridescence.
physical_description.build: Slight and angular, almost ascetic—minimal muscle mass but precise posture suggesting deliberate physical control. Narrow shoulders, long-limbed proportions that read as slightly fragile despite evident discipline.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with chromatic root-shift (copper to pale violet) that intensifies with emotional activation—geneware expression of neural state
physical_description.hair_style: Straight, combed back cleanly, maintained with clinical precision
physical_description.eye_color: Patterned irises: geometric spirograph in copper and pale green that rotates—slow rotation indicates focus, rapid rotation indicates agitation
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with luminous golden undertones—the radiant synthesis of Middle Eastern, Sub-Saharan African, South Asian, and Central Asian genetic heritage. Rich, polished appearance with even, radiant undertones suggesting complex multicontinental layering.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, high-cheekboned facial structure reflecting Middle Eastern and Central Asian ancestry; warm, deep complexion enriched and luminized by Sub-Saharan African and South Asian heritage; mild, somewhat distant expression; impeccable grooming; minimal facial hair (clean-shaven); skin shows no scarring or blemishes—carefully maintained. The complexion carries subtle warmth and luminosity characteristic of this rare ancestry blend, with refined geometric bone structure and glowing brown depths.
distinguishing_marks: Subtle subdermal tracery visible along left temple (neural resonance implant access point), faint iridescent shimmer under certain light angles
Long-fingered hands marked by microlacerations and faint scar tissue on fingertips from years of precision calibration work—nearly invisible to untrained observation
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Kinetic spirograph irises are immediately striking and clearly non-natural; subtle iridescence along left temporal region where neural resonance implant integrates with skin. No obvious chrome or exoskeletal augmentation—all augmentations are neurological/subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision, as if calibrated himself. Hands remain almost completely still even during conversation—a learned occupational habit. Walks slowly, deliberately, with awareness of fragile equipment around him. Affects mild emotional distance masked by serene confidence. When engaged in work, becomes almost meditative in stillness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 corporate-adjacent professional: charcoal or navy compression-weave shirts (thermoregulating, durable) under lightweight lab coats bearing Aurochs Medical Complex insignia and embroidered credentials. Dark fitted trousers. Minimal jewelry except for a thin platinum band on left ring finger (possibly medical alert or neural interface synchronizer). Shoes: premium synthetic leather, orthopedic—built for long standing. Overall aesthetic is clean, precise, slightly ascetic. No visible brand-flexing or ornamentation. Suggests someone who allocates resources toward equipment and experience rather than status display.
